premises.text: Combustion power plants are inefficient, inflexible, and emit large amounts of CO2 while still supplying most energy
premises.evidence_span: These combustion power plants fail. They are highly inefficient, they are not flexible, and they emit millions of tons of CO2

premises.text: System combines solid oxide fuel cells, a CO2 separation unit, and a methanation reactor in a new closed-cycle design
premises.evidence_span: Our technology combines three major building blocks in a new and unique way

premises.text: Eliminating combustion and closing the cycle yields 100% fuel conversion and 80% electric efficiency
premises.evidence_span: we have eliminated the combustion completely. By adding the two components that we showed before to the fuel cells and operating the system in a closed cycle, we achieve 100% fuel conversion and 80% electric efficiency

premises.text: Outputs are water and pure CO2 as a valuable product rather than off-gas
premises.evidence_span: there is no off-gas anymore, but we just produce water and pure CO2, which now becomes a valuable product

premises.text: System is reversible: can produce gas (hydrogen or methane) from excess power
premises.evidence_span: our new system design is reversible, meaning it can also produce gas from excess power

premises.text: First market is biogas plants: power when renewables are scarce; store energy and enable negative emissions when surplus
premises.evidence_span: Biogas plants are our first target market

premises.text: Doubling electric efficiency doubles electricity revenue; reversible operation can more than fivefold customer income
premises.evidence_span: doubling in electric efficiency first of all means doubling revenues from electricity. With the additional revenues from the reversible operation, they can overall more than fivefold their income

value.text: Decentralized, carbon-negative, highly efficient power generation
value.evidence_span: provide the world with decentralized, carbon negative, and highly efficient power plants

secondary_value.text: Long-term storage of biogenic CO2 enables negative CO2 emissions
secondary_value.evidence_span: Long-term storage of this biogenic CO2, in turn, enables negative CO2 emissions
